title: Strange Evidence
description:
S07 E03 — North Korean Fire Blast
Cameras capture an enormous fireball erupting along with a series of explosions in a North Korean border town; experts investigate and discover a cramped and overcrowded housing project linked to a deadly propane tank disaster.

description:

description:

description:
The Jericho Head
In 1953, a team of archaeologists uncovers a bizarre, plastered human skull in the ancient city of Jericho; experts investigate the mysterious purpose and identity behind this 9,000-year-old clay-covered artifact.

title: Strangest Things
description:
The Macabre Hat of Teeth
A museum in South London contains a disturbing tattered hat made of brown felt and decorated with more than 80 human teeth; using the latest imaging technology, experts investigate to uncover the macabre origins of this mysterious Victorian-era cap.

description:
S05 E07 — The Moon's Strange Secret
The last humans to walk on the Moon discover something strange on the surface; a NASA scientist investigates a strange phenomenon responsible for horrific mass deaths; a landmark NASA mission threatens to destroy the reputation of an American hero.

title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S01 E05 — Interstellar Gold Rush
A distant planet shows an Earth-like atmosphere; a glowing light suggests an atmosphere on the Moon; why there are blueberries on Mars.

title: Killers of the Cosmos
description:
S01 E03 — Cosmic Scrap
More than 100 million pieces of small space debris are floating around the Earth; a collision between two of these objects in low Earth orbit could be catastrophic.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S07 E06 — Did the Big Bang Really Happen?
New discoveries cause astronomers to question if the Big Bang really happened; using the latest science, they investigate if it wasn't just the start of the universe but many mysterious multiverses.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S07 E10 — Cassini's Final Secrets
For twenty years, NASA's Cassini spacecraft revealed the strange secrets of Saturn until it vaporized in its atmosphere in a blaze of glory; but today its legacy lives on, as fresh data from the probe helps scientists make brand-new discoveries.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S08 E03 — Hunt for Alien Evidence
The discovery of extraterrestrial life might face an impossible challenge: the physics of the universe itself; using cutting-edge tech, experts might be on the verge of a groundbreaking find, and the evidence could already be in hand.

title: Engineering on the Edge
description:
S01 E04 — Space Needle
Trask and his team take on the iconic Space Needle in Seattle to fix an aging window-washing basket; in San Antonio, they look to get a stadium ready for game day.

title: Engineering on the Edge
description:
S01 E05 — Foresthill Bridge
Trask and his crew look for any critical issues on Foresthill Bridge in California, a vital escape route during wildfires; in Garden City, Kan., the team needs to inspect massive grain elevators where one spark could ignite a devastating explosion.

title: Engineering on the Edge
description:
S01 E01 — Pegasus and Dragon
Trask and his crew take on one of the world's largest bronze statues, Pegasus and Dragon, and they need to figure out how to get on this colossus of a structure; one of the world's largest roller coasters is due for an inspection.

title: Engineering on the Edge
description:
S01 E06 — New Bullards Dam
Trask and his crew take on New Bullards Dam, and they need to place critical target sensors for monitoring seismic activity; in Colorado, a bird detection system needs to be installed at a wind turbine facility.

title: Engineering on the Edge
description:
S01 E03 — Sutro Tower
Trask and his crew scale Sutro Tower to inspect crucial cable junctions and must avoid deadly radiation at nearly 1,000 feet in the air; in Oregon, loose boulders need to be removed along a cliffside road that needs to be reopened.

title: Engineering on the Edge
description:
S01 E02 — Frying Pan Tower
Trask takes on a decommissioned lighthouse 32 miles off the coast of North Carolina, and the crew must work suspended above shark-infested waters; an aging stadium with corroding catwalks needs maintenance for hockey season.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S06 E10 — Bay Area Bridge of Mayhem
A devastating earthquake wreaks havoc on an iconic San Francisco bridge and leaves drivers fearing for their lives; experts use the latest science to investigate and uncover a weakened expansion joint caused by catastrophic shockwaves.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S06 E06 — Manhattan Crane Chaos
New York residents get a rude awakening when a disastrous crane collapse causes chaos on the downtown streets of Manhattan; experts use the latest tech to investigate and reveal how a slight increase in wind conditions created major catastrophe.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S05 E01 — Texas Fertilizer Catastrophe
A deadly explosion strikes at the heart of a small Texas town and leaves a community in ruins; experts use the latest science to investigate and uncover a nearby fertilizer plant containing volatile chemicals poised for disaster.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S06 E02 — Miami's Condo Catastrophe
Catastrophe strikes Miami, Fla., as a 13-story condominium tower collapses with deadly debris; experts use the latest science to investigate and uncover an uncontrolled method of demolition that led to catastrophic failure.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S06 E04 — Memphis Bridge of Doom
A vital Mississippi River interstate crossing is discovered to be in danger of imminent collapse in Memphis; experts use the latest science to investigate and uncover severely compromised load-bearing tension members with a life-threatening weakness.

description:

description:
S01 E04 — Little Green Men
Aliens could be lethal killers who want to invade and plunder our world; a team of experts investigates extra-terrestrial beings and their threat to human life.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S07 E09 — Finding the New Earth
New discoveries have revealed thousands of exoplanets beyond the solar system, and some resemble earth enough that one could be a new home for humanity; with cutting-edge technology, finding the perfect one is the scientific challenge of the age.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S07 E03 — The Interstellar Mysteries
Discoveries about interstellar space, the space between the universe's stars, reveal that it's not empty and unremarkable as previously thought, but filled with weird objects and strange phenomena that might hold the darkest secrets of the cosmos.

title: Mysteries of the Missing
description:
S01 E02 — Atlantis: The Lost Evidence
Atlantis is one of the most famous disappearances of all time; after thousands of years, state-of-the-art technology might finally be able to crack this ancient mystery; after nine hikers die in a gruesome cold case, new science provides a hot lead.

title: Mysteries of the Missing
description:
S01 E05 — Forbidden City of Gold
New technology reveals lost cities in inhospitable jungle; researchers wonder if the mythical city of El Dorado could be the next discovery; after a crystal is found on a shipwreck, experts believe it could prove how the Vikings discovered America.

title: Mysteries of the Missing
description:
S01 E04 — The Men Who Beat Alcatraz
In 1962, three convicts attempt the impossible and escape from Alcatraz prison; officials believe the men drowned, but a new scientific experiment suggests they made it to shore.

title: Mysteries of the Missing
description:
S01 E03 — Ghost Ship of the Desert
A huge cargo ship suddenly vanishes with 27 crew members on board; new evidence suggests the culprit may be a mythical rogue wave; recently discovered evidence could prove the existence of a ghost ship in the Californian desert.

title: Mysteries of the Missing
description:
S01 E08 — Flight of Terror
In 2009, an Air France flight goes missing, and investigators discover this tragedy could happen again; after a huge area of Siberian forest is destroyed, investigators race to find the culprit; new evidence might solve this century-old mystery.

title: Mysteries of the Missing
description:
S01 E06 — Lost Colony of Roanoke
The Roanoke colony vanishes without a trace, and centuries later, it remains one of history's greatest unsolved mysteries; but new evidence might at last reveal its fate; after a man is swallowed by earth, experts wonder if a sinkhole is to blame.

title: Mysteries of the Missing
description:
S01 E07 — Curse of the Bermuda Triangle
After five planes vanish in the Bermuda Triangle, new science suggests a strange geological force is responsible; satellites reveal lost tribes living in the Amazon jungle, but some civilizations remain missing, stumping experts.

description:
S11 E08 — High-Rise Hotel Battlefield
A slice of the Miami suburbs stands out for its style and history; a hotel in Lebanon carries the scars of a civil war; a pirate radio station gets a mixed reception.

description:
S11 E06 — Ghost Skeleton Coast

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S11 E05 — The Desert Pirates
Desert bunkers in Tunisia block Allied victory in Africa; the pride of one Alabama community is born out of a harsh reality; a Lebanese complex is rocked by a massive explosion; the remains of an elite institution still stand in Greece.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S11 E03 — Operation Just Cause
A military base in Panama becomes a battleground between American forces and a drug-running tyrant; a life cut short in Italy turns a utopian dream into a nightmare; a grisly Polish facility finds itself caught between two regimes.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S11 E02 — Schindler's Deception
A place of hope in the Czech Republic quietly perseveres in the age of Nazi tyranny; a Moroccan politician sides with the French; an eco-friendly paradise in the Amazon proves to be unsustainable.

A NASA astronaut reports seeing a flying saucer in the skies above a U.S. Air Force test range; how the swirling gases of Saturn have formed a perfect hexagon that has hovered above the planet's pole for 30 years.

Experts discuss the many possible ways that could spark the beginning of the end for the universe, including when and why it would happen.

description:

Nebulas are the strange structures of cosmic gas and dust where stars are born and die, and new discoveries reveal the secrets of these mysterious places.

description:

Black holes are not the violent monsters people think they are, and new discoveries reveal that they might have been essential to creating stars, giving light, and building the universe itself.

description:
S11 E05 — Solar System Special
Exploring new discoveries that rewrite the history of the solar system, revealing a complex and violent story that begins with the birth of the sun from the debris of a massive galactic collision to its eventual fate as a lone zombie star.

title: Houdini's Last Secrets
description:
S01 E01 — The Torture Escape
No one knows how Harry Houdini pulled off his death-defying escapes, but now a team of experts investigates his water torture illusion to reveal the secrets of this mysterious feat.

title: Houdini's Last Secrets
description:
S01 E02 — To Catch a Bullet
The bullet catch is one of the deadliest tricks in magic history, and no one knows if Houdini pulled off the illusion; a team of experts re-creates the famed trick to uncover how Houdini could have pulled off the feat that killed many of his peers.

title: Houdini's Last Secrets
description:
S01 E03 — Siberian Prison Conspiracy
One of Houdini's greatest escapes might have been a deep-cover conspiracy to spy for the American government, and experts recreate his break from a Siberian prison transport to investigate the mysteries behind this incredible feat.

title: Houdini's Last Secrets
description:
S01 E04 — Buried Alive
Houdini's mysterious sudden death might not have been an accident, and experts re-create his buried alive escape to reveal how this deadly feat was performed and if the great magician was killed by forces far more insidious.

description:
S04 E05 — Mystery of Fang Forest
A strange forest of razor-sharp stones could be home of an undiscovered Hobbit-like humanoid species; when a man-made island mysteriously appears off the U.S. coast, new evidence points to secret government experiments into psycho-chemical warfare.
